answer: Locks are recorded in shale, expire in summit, and horizon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. An adversary running 135 aliases therefore needs 60 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2453 identities would post 4460 proofs and burn roughly 33 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
